1.w: Praise the Lord! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in the sky, which testifies to his strength!

2.w: Praise him for his mighty acts; praise him for his surpassing greatness!

3.w: Praise him with the blast of the horn; praise him with the lyre and the harp!

4.w: Praise him with the tambourine and with dancing; praise him with stringed instruments and the flute!

5.w: Praise him with loud cymbals; praise him with clanging cymbals!

6.w: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
